snippet.title: New Unreal Engine 5 Game Project: 'Hydro' | DEV LOG #1
snippet.description:
Wishlist and get the Demo here! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3355830/Hydro/

Here's Dev Log #1, a sneak-peek behind the scenes of my current project within Unreal Engine 5...a game which is currently going by the name of 'Hydro'.

This is a very heavy work-in-progress at present - lots has been done but there is SO much more work to go!

I'm hoping you'll enjoy this preview of the game and I hope to drop more Dev Logs in the coming months as I (hopefully) develop the title further towards demo/early access/full release. 

Enjoy and please remember to like, comment and subscribe for more updates!
